title: Telegram rate-budget lease leak and delivery recoverability (P0 fixes from 2026-09-02 incident report)

AC1.note: tests/unit/telegram-rate-budget.test.ts 'AC1 — conservation' passes: refresh with a nonzero local remainder adds the new grant instead of replacing it (utils/telegram-rate-budget.ts refreshNow(): tokens += granted).

AC2.note: tests/unit/telegram-rate-budget.test.ts 'AC2 — idle' passes: 12 allowances that never call acquire() leave the shared bucket row (tokens, updated_at) completely untouched across 36 explicit refreshNow() calls — hasDemand gate, set only by acquire(), makes refreshNow() a strict no-op until real demand exists.

AC3.note: tests/unit/telegram-rate-budget.test.ts 'AC3 — fairness' passes: a real acquire() call gets a slot within 2s despite concurrent idle refreshNow() activity, since idle instances never touch the bucket at all (subsumes the original scenario — idle can't starve what it can't touch). Independently verified by review-testing-practices via revert-and-rerun.

AC4.note: tests/unit/pending-replies-recovery-worker.test.ts passes: startPendingReplyRecoveryWorker (channel/recovery.ts) delivers a stale pending_replies row on a bounded interval independent of bot startup; wired alongside the existing startup call in main.ts.

AC5.note: tests/unit/pending-reply-premark-crash-recovery.test.ts passes: premark/unmark around a send attempt is awaited and state-machine-driven (pending/sending/delivered/failed/partial, migration v54). Review fix: deliverPendingReplies now also recovers 'sending' rows older than 30s, closing a real-process-crash gap found in review (T4) that the test's simulated-delay scenario didn't cover.

AC6.note: tests/unit/stop-hook-turn-closed-gate.test.ts passes: mcp/server.ts's deliverTurnSummary checks each part's send .ok and withholds turn_closed pg_notify on failure, inserting a status='failed' pending_replies row instead so the recovery worker retries it.

AC7.note: tests/unit/reply-chunk-partial-delivery-state.test.ts passes: a second-chunk send failure sets pending_replies.status='partial', not 'delivered'; sendReplyChunks' existing lost-chunk count drives the terminal state in channel/tools.ts.

AC8.note: tests/unit/poller-ack-before-delivered.test.ts passes: channel/poller.ts's claim query sets claimed_at (migration v55) instead of delivered=true; delivered=true is only set once mcp.notification actually resolves; a fast reject reverts delivered=false, claimed_at=NULL.

AC9.note: tests/unit/supervisor-rescue-dedup-index.test.ts passes against real Postgres with idx_queue_msgid_dedup in place: scripts/supervisor.ts's rescue now does INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (chat_id, message_id) DO UPDATE instead of a colliding plain INSERT.

AC10.note: bun run typecheck: clean. bun run lint: clean (0 errors, 260 pre-existing warnings unrelated to this flow). bun test tests/unit/: 2545 pass / 2 fail — both pre-existing, unrelated tts-external-boundary failures present on main before this flow, unchanged by any change in this flow including the T4 review-fix round.
